page.headline: Different expertise. A shared purpose.
page.intro: We combine commercial thinking, design and technical engineering to help businesses identify opportunities, build the right solutions and achieve measurable growth.
page.secondaryHeadline: Real people. Real experience. Real results for our clients.
page.secondaryCopy: Each team member plays a specific role in helping clients move from idea to impact. Select a profile to see how they contribute and how their work benefits the client.

members.name: Bokamoso Jadian Motlopi
members.cardValue: Helps clients identify growth opportunities and turn them into practical action.
members.profileHeadline: Helping clients turn growth opportunities into practical action.
members.profileIntro: Bokamoso works with clients to identify where growth is being lost, where customer journeys or sales processes are underperforming, and what changes will create the greatest impact.
bio: Bokamoso helps businesses identify growth opportunities and determine the most effective way to act on them. His background spans sales, digital marketing and client acquisition, giving him a practical understanding of how businesses attract customers, convert opportunities and build the systems required to sustain growth.

He works closely with clients to understand their objectives, identify gaps in their current processes and translate those findings into practical technology and growth strategies. His focus is ensuring that solutions such as websites, CRM platforms and business systems are aligned with the organisation’s actual priorities.
members.clientJourneyTitle: How Bokamoso helps clients move businesses forward

clientJourney.title: Clarity on the opportunity
clientJourney.copy: Understand what is holding growth back and identify the opportunities worth pursuing.

clientJourney.title: Stronger customer acquisition
clientJourney.copy: Improve how the business attracts, reaches and engages the right audience.

clientJourney.title: Better conversion
clientJourney.copy: Reduce friction between interest, lead handling and sales so more opportunities become real results.

clientJourney.title: Systems that support growth
clientJourney.copy: Align the right website, CRM and business systems with the sales process and customer journey.

clientJourney.title: Sustainable growth
clientJourney.copy: Connect commercial priorities with practical actions and systems that can scale with the business.

members.clientOutcome: A clearer path to measurable and sustainable growth.

members.name: Frank Ndlovu
members.cardValue: Turns complex business requirements into reliable technology systems.
members.profileHeadline: Turning complex business requirements into reliable technology systems.
members.profileIntro: Frank works with clients to understand how their business operates and translate that into practical, scalable technology solutions.
bio: From custom software and business applications to APIs, databases, integrations, automation, cloud infrastructure and security, Frank leads the consultancy’s deeper technical delivery.

His role is to ensure that the right solution is designed, built, integrated and supported around the client’s real operational requirements rather than forcing the business into a generic technical model.
members.clientJourneyTitle: How Frank helps clients move from problem to solution

clientJourney.title: Understand the operation
clientJourney.copy: Analyse the business workflow, requirements and technical constraints to identify the right approach.

clientJourney.title: Design the architecture
clientJourney.copy: Define how applications, databases, APIs, identity, infrastructure and third-party systems should work together.

clientJourney.title: Build the solution
clientJourney.copy: Develop custom software, APIs and business logic tailored to the client’s actual requirements.

clientJourney.title: Integrate and automate
clientJourney.copy: Connect systems and remove repetitive manual work through reliable integrations and automation.

clientJourney.title: Make it dependable
clientJourney.copy: Build in security, deployment, monitoring and maintainability so the solution can operate reliably as the business grows.

members.clientOutcome: Technology that fits the business rather than forcing the business to fit the technology.

members.name: Matthew
members.cardValue: Designs and builds polished, responsive websites that help businesses communicate clearly and turn visitors into customers.
members.profileHeadline: Designing clear, responsive digital experiences that turn business ideas into effective websites.
members.profileIntro: Matthew works with clients to understand what their website needs to communicate, who it needs to reach and what action visitors should take.
bio: From visual direction and page structure to responsive layouts, interactions and Framer implementation, Matthew turns business requirements into polished digital experiences that are clear, usable and aligned with the client’s brand.

His role is to make sure the website is not only visually strong, but also structured around the client’s goals, content and customer journey rather than design decisions that exist purely for appearance.
members.clientJourneyTitle: How Matthew helps clients move from idea to digital experience

clientJourney.title: Understand the business
clientJourney.copy: Understand the client’s goals, audience, content and desired customer journey before making design decisions.

clientJourney.title: Define the experience
clientJourney.copy: Plan the website structure, page hierarchy and user journey so visitors can quickly understand the business and take the right action.

clientJourney.title: Design the interface
clientJourney.copy: Create clear, responsive page designs that balance usability, brand identity and visual consistency.

clientJourney.title: Build in Framer
clientJourney.copy: Turn the approved design into a responsive Framer website with polished layouts, interactions and reusable components.

clientJourney.title: Refine the experience
clientJourney.copy: Review responsiveness, usability, content presentation and interactions to ensure the finished website works consistently across devices.

members.clientOutcome: A website that communicates clearly, represents the business professionally and guides visitors toward meaningful action.
members.profileValue: Designs and builds polished digital experiences that help businesses communicate clearly and convert visitors into customers.

workingTogether.headline: From opportunity to real-world impact.
workingTogether.intro: Our team combines commercial insight, design and technical engineering to deliver solutions that create measurable value for the business.

steps.title: Understand the opportunity
steps.copy: Start by understanding the business, its goals and where value is being lost.

steps.title: Define the solution
steps.copy: Determine the right mix of strategy, design and technology for the client’s needs.

steps.title: Design and build
steps.copy: Design and develop websites, systems and integrations tailored to the business.

steps.title: Deliver the outcome
steps.copy: Deliver practical solutions that improve efficiency, conversion and long-term growth.
